scripts.lint: biome check src && tsc --noEmit && node scripts/check-harmony-types.js && node scripts/check-native-spec-parity.js
scripts.build:ios-debug: cd Example/e2etest && bun && bunx detox build --configuration ios.sim.debug
scripts.build:ios-release: cd Example/e2etest && bun && bunx detox build --configuration ios.sim.release
scripts.test:ios-debug: cd Example/e2etest && E2E_PLATFORM=ios bunx detox test --configuration ios.sim.debug
scripts.test:ios-release: cd Example/e2etest && E2E_PLATFORM=ios bunx detox test --configuration ios.sim.release
scripts.build:android-debug: cd Example/e2etest && bun && bunx detox build --configuration android.emu.debug
scripts.build:android-release: cd Example/e2etest && bun && bunx detox build --configuration android.emu.release
scripts.test:android-release: cd Example/e2etest && E2E_PLATFORM=android bunx detox test --configuration android.emu.release --headless --record-logs all
scripts.test:android-debug: cd Example/e2etest && E2E_PLATFORM=android bunx detox test --configuration android.emu.debug --headless --record-logs all
scripts.smoke:android-debug: cd Example/e2etest && bunx detox test --configuration android.emu.debug --config e2e/smoke/jest.config.js
